hypotheses.justification: The existing proof works unchanged without _hy. Unfolding xLift and dilation_apply reduces the equality to cancellation of r in (r * y.2.1) / (r * y.1), using Real.rpow_zero and mul_div_mul_left with hr.ne'. This requires no positivity of y.1 and remains valid when y.1 = 0, since the cancellation lemma also covers zero denominators.
